headline: AI‑driven deals lifted several firms, but overall revenue growth slowed for the larger players.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from modest double‑digit for the majors to over 50% for Coforge. Profit margins improved for HCLTech and Coforge, while Infosys and Wipro saw profit pressure. Guidance was trimmed by Infosys and introduced by HCLTech and Wipro. AI revenue contributions were highlighted across most companies.

themes.title: AI‑led deal wins
themes.detail: AI‑related contracts accounted for a large share of new business, boosting revenue at LTM, Mphasis and HCLTech.

themes.title: Margin divergence
themes.detail: Operating margins rose above 20% at Infosys and TCS, but fell sharply at OFSS and Wipro.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance; HCLTech and Wipro introduced modest outlooks.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
13.6% revenue growth with AI revenue up 47% YoY.
Profit jumped 21% YoY, driven by strong AI revenue.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and profit margin guidance was cut.
Revenue grew 9.1% but profit fell 1.9% and margin pressure persisted.
Revenue grew 30% but profit dropped 25% YoY, indicating cost issues.

domain_outlook.note: Mphasis highlighted telecom engineering growth; other firms gave no telecom signals.
